Legislative Line-Items and Special Programs

The KYGA Line-Item Appropriations administered by the Office of State Grants, provides financial assistance for projects and initiatives specifically authorized through appropriations made by the Kentucky General Assembly. These funds support local governments, public entities, and eligible organizations in carrying out community improvement, infrastructure, public service, economic development, and other locally significant projects identified through the state budgeting process. The program is administered by the Kentucky Department for Local Government's Office of State Grants.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligible recipients are entities identified in legislative appropriations and designated to the Kentucky Department for Local Government for distribution to local governments, public agencies, SPGEs, and other authorized recipients. Applicants must comply with all program, reporting, and terms and conditions outlined in the Memorandum of Agreement.

Required Documentation

Completed application, project scope, budget, authorizing documentation, and any additional materials required by DLG or the legislative appropriation.

Award Details

The Kentucky General Assembly determines line-item funding allocations through the state budgeting process. Award amounts, eligible recipients, and project requirements may vary depending on the specific legislative appropriation. DLG administers awarded funds and oversees compliance, reporting, and disbursement requirements

Application Process

Submit a complete application and required supporting documentation to DLG's Office of State Grants. Applications are reviewed for eligibility and compliance before awards are issued and administered.
